title: Bengaluru Kere Atlas
description:
Live version: https://adityaratnam09.github.io/BengaluruKereAtlas/

An interactive atlas of water quality in Bengaluru's lakes, built from the monthly reports of the Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB). It provides lake profiles, a Lake Pressure Index, seasonal comparison, satellite comparison and a citywide table of flagged data errors. This record is a dated snapshot of the atlas; the live site is updated as new reports are published.
